sections.heading: Housework
sections.body:
*las tareas de la casa / los quehaceres* (chores): *limpiar* (to clean), *barrer* (to sweep), *trapear* (to mop — *fregar el suelo* in Spain), *lavar los platos* (to wash the dishes), *lavar la ropa* (to do the laundry), *planchar* (to iron), *hacer la cama* (to make the bed), *sacar la basura* (to take out the trash), *pasar la aspiradora* (to vacuum), *cocinar*, *regar las plantas* (to water the plants), *ordenar* (to tidy up).

*Me toca a mí* (It's my turn): *Hoy me toca lavar los platos.* *¿A quién le toca sacar la basura?*

sections.heading: Impersonal se: people in general
sections.body: *Se* + third-person verb talks about what people do in general, without saying who: *Aquí se habla español.* (Spanish is spoken here.) *¿Cómo se dice "trash" en español?* (How do you say…?) *No se puede fumar.* (You can't smoke / Smoking isn't allowed.) *Se come bien en este restaurante.* (You eat well at this restaurant.)

sections.heading: Passive se: things being done
sections.body:
When there's a thing, the verb agrees with it: singular or plural.

- *Se vende casa.* (House for sale.) *Se venden casas.* (Houses for sale.)
- *Se necesita mesero.* / *Se necesitan meseros.* (Waiter / waiters needed — *camarero* in Spain.)
- *Se alquila apartamento.* (Apartment for rent.)
- *Los platos se lavan con agua caliente.* (Dishes are washed with hot water.)

You'll see this form on signs, in recipes and in instructions everywhere.

examples: Hoy me toca lavar los platos.
Today it's my turn to wash the dishes.
¿A quién le toca sacar la basura?
Whose turn is it to take out the trash?
Hago la cama todas las mañanas.

On Saturdays we clean the house.
Mi hermano nunca ordena su cuarto.
My brother never tidies his room.
I water the plants on Mondays.
How do you say "trash" in Spanish?
Se come muy bien en este restaurante.
You eat very well at this restaurant.
Se alquila apartamento en el centro.
Los platos se lavan con agua caliente.
Dishes are washed with hot water.
Barro la cocina y después trapeo.
I sweep the kitchen and then I mop.
I do the laundry on Sundays.
How do you spell your name?
